meta.title: RFQ bid: Price above the buyer's price cap

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Provide the required event title.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the capped RFQ line item.
Complete the pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Commit a live bidding window.
Invite the configured QA vendor used for Vendor A.
Publish the RFQ before configuring participants and bidding.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real published project page.
Open the published RFQ participant list to configure the vendor cap.
Set the buyer's price cap to 100 for the first invited vendor.
Verify that the cap was saved for the vendor.
Move to the separate vendor portal while retaining the buyer session.
Open this live RFQ's pricing sheet as the invited vendor.
Enter a quote above the configured cap.

args.because: Price cannot be more than the allowed price

steps.note: Submit the over-cap quote and require Procol's cap refusal.
Replace the refused quote with the allowed cap value.
Submit the quote at the cap.
Confirm the vendor portal accepted the quote of 100.
